title: DoorDash is going airborne with new drone delivery division
excerpt: DoorDash announced DoorDash Air, its new drone delivery division. The company received approval from the FAA to launch its own commercial service.
content_html:
DoorDash is launching a new drone delivery program called DoorDash Air. The largest food delivery app in the US said that it has approval from the Federal Aviation Administration that clears the way for drone delivery in the near future.

DoorDash said it has received a Part 135 air carrier certification from the FAA that enable it to delivery small packages via drone. Other companies to receive this designation include Alphabet’s Wing, Zipline, and Amazon.

Previously, DoorDash worked with Alphabet’s drone delivery division Wing on a number of pilots in places like Dallas-Fort Worth, Virginia, and Australia. Now the company says it will deploy its own drones, designed specifically for food delivery. The drones will be designed and assembled within the company’s DoorDash Labs division, which houses its robotics and AI teams responsible for building its Dot sidewalk delivery robots.

“We’re designing an aircraft purpose-built for the gaps we see in local commerce, and it complements the short- and long-range designs our partners are scaling,” the company said in a press release. “Our drone is also proudly American-designed and built, with the majority of components made right here in the U.S.” (To be sure, the vast majority of drones are manufactured in China.)

In addition, DoorDash says it will also build all the necessary ground-level infrastructure to enable restaurants to hand off their deliveries to drones. As seen with other drone delivery pilots, there is a complex system of structures and additional equipment that needs to be built on the ground to enable drones to pickup their payloads before embarking on their deliveries. And there are flight plans, airspace management, and drop-off logistics that needs to be established to track the drones in flight. DoorDash says its committed to building all that infrastructure itself.

“The aircraft is what everyone sees,” the company says. “The harder problem is the infrastructure and integration on the ground, and that’s our advantage. Solving hard physical-world problems for local businesses is our focus, from real-time inventory reconciliation to universal handoff systems for drive-throughs, rooftops, or merchant back doors. We are building that complete end-to-end system.”

DoorDash says drone delivery could solve the problem of midrange deliveries that still end up taking longer because couriers are hard to find. The company says more than 20 percent of its orders involve distances of three to five miles, but that those orders can take on average nearly 25 percent longer than shorter deliveries, largely because finding a courier takes longer for these mid-range trips.

“Routing mid-range deliveries to drones lets Dashers focus on the orders they often favor: shorter deliveries that can be done quickly, staying near a high concentration of merchants for optimal routing, and maximizing their earning potential by getting them to their next order faster,” the company says.

DoorDash didn’t reveal which markets it was targeting for its initial launch, noting that it would announce more details in the months to come.

content_html_zh:
DoorDash 正在启动一项名为 DoorDash Air 的新无人机送货计划。 美国最大的食品配送应用程序表示，它已获得美国联邦航空管理局的批准，为不久的将来无人机配送扫清了道路。

DoorDash 表示，它已获得美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 第 135 部分航空承运人认证，使其能够通过无人机运送小包裹。 其他获得此称号的公司包括 Alphabet 旗下的 Wing、Zipline 和亚马逊。

此前，DoorDash 曾与 Alphabet 的无人机配送部门 Wing 在达拉斯-沃斯堡、弗吉尼亚州和澳大利亚等地进行过多次试点。 现在该公司表示将部署自己的无人机，专为食品配送而设计。 这些无人机将在该公司的 DoorDash Labs 部门内设计和组装，该部门的机器人和人工智能团队负责建造 Dot 人行道送货机器人。

该公司在一份新闻稿中表示：“我们正在设计一款专门针对当地商业缺口而设计的飞机，它补充了我们合作伙伴正在扩展的短期和长期设计。” “我们的无人机也是美国设计和制造的，大部分部件都是在美国制造的。” （可以肯定的是，绝大多数无人机都是在中国制造的。）

此外，DoorDash 表示还将建设所有必要的地面基础设施，使餐厅能够将送货工作交给无人机。 正如其他无人机送货飞行员所见，需要在地面上建造一个由结构和附加设备组成的复杂系统，以使无人机能够在开始送货之前拾取有效载荷。 还需要制定飞行计划、空域管理和投放物流来跟踪飞行中的无人机。 DoorDash 表示，它致力于自行构建所有基础设施。

“这架飞机是每个人都能看到的，”该公司表示。 “更困难的问题是当地的基础设施和整合，这就是我们的优势。 我们的重点是为当地企业解决现实世界中的难题，从实时库存核对到汽车餐厅、屋顶或商家后门的​​通用交接系统。 我们正在构建完整的端到端系统。”

DoorDash 表示，无人机送货可以解决中程送货的问题，但由于快递员很难找到，最终仍然需要更长的时间。 该公司表示，超过 20% 的订单涉及 3 至 5 英里的距离，但这些订单平均比短途配送要多花近 25% 的时间，这主要是因为这些中距离行程寻找快递员需要更长的时间。

该公司表示：“通过无人机进行中程送货，可以让 Dasher 专注于他们经常喜欢的订单：可以快速完成的较短送货，靠近高度集中的商家以获得最佳路线，并通过让他们更快地到达下一个订单来最大化他们的收入潜力。”

DoorDash 没有透露其首次推出的目标市场，并指出将在未来几个月内公布更多细节。
